column1: # Per-symbol policy for OVRPlugin exports that no source file implements (tier `impl`).
# Columns (TAB separated): name, tier, note.   tier = unsupported | ok | ret=<int>
# Anything not listed here is `unsupported` (returns ovrpFailure_Unsupported).
# Add an `ok` line ONLY when (a) the real signature is known and (b) the game cannot observe the
# difference between "applied" and "ignored". Find candidates with:
#   adb logcat -d -s OLFX-OVR > run.log && tools/ovr_shim/gen_policy.py --suggest run.log
# Regenerate with tools/ovr_shim/gen_policy.py; tests fail if olfx_extra_stubs.c is stale.
